articles.title: Why the TradFi takeover of crypto might not be the death blow analysts expect
articles.snippet: Gate’s CBO argues that Bloomberg’s warning of a TradFi takeover is "oversimplified," noting that global exchanges evolved past fee-only models years ago.

articles.title: Bitcoin ‘golden cross’ appears for the first time since 2023: Will BTC price rally?
articles.snippet: Bitcoin’s MVRV suggests a shift to bullish momentum as BTC's market structure strengthens, which may be an early sign of a new bull market.

articles.title: Bitcoin rallies 2.3% after Trump calls Iran peace proposal ‘totally unacceptable’
articles.snippet: 10x Research CEO Markus Thielen said Bitcoin’s strength above $80,000 could be supported by two favorable decisions in the US Senate this week.
